verdict.rationale: The evidence describes VirtualPostMail only as a hosted service: a cloud-stored mailbox, physical mail handling at its facilities, and a gated hosted API at api.virtualpostmail.com. Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment, downloadable software, or source release of the core product. The partner platform offering is a resold hosted service, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
